analyzed_vuln.description: In Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject, when decoding an unwrapped ExtensionObject body, dst->data is allocated and assigned, then on decodeFields() failure it is freed with UA_free(dst->data) but not nulled and not fully cleared via UA_delete/UA_clear. The function returns an error with dst->type still set and dst->data still pointing to freed memory. Later cleanup (UA_decodeJson error path -> UA_clear -> Variant_clear -> UA_Array_delete -> LocalizedText_clear/String_clear) treats the variant as initialized and dereferences/frees the dangling pointer, causing heap-use-after-free/double-free-style cleanup on freed storage.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires JSON decoded as a Variant where Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject takes the structure-unwrapping path (TypeId present and resolves to a known datatype, e.g. Id 21 LocalizedText), allocates dst->data, and then body decoding fails (malformed/inconsistent Body such as the PoC). On this error path, dst->data is freed but left dangling; subsequent top-level UA_decodeJson cleanup of the partially decoded Variant accesses that freed object, producing the ASan UAF.
